## Details

<a id="script_ops"></a>
### [`script_ops`](../../../../src/script/opcode_table.asm#L6) `$4525-$4570`

*data*

Address table of the 38 script opcodes (0-37). Opcode n uses the word at script_ops + 2 * n. Opcodes 6, 7, 10, 17-26 and 29-34 are in no script of the program that a scan from the run_script calls finds.

- **Read by:** [`script_dispatch`](interpreter.md#script_dispatch)
